title: Uttar Pradesh Assembly 2027

NDA.note: RLD and SBSP switched from SP bloc (2022) to NDA; tau transfer applied on AE baseline, full weight at GE2024 where they already contested as NDA

INDIA.note: SP+INC allied at GE2024 (full weight); INC separate at AE2022 (tau transfer). Seat-sharing NOT yet agreed as of freeze

poll_corrections.rule: 0.5 x mean of UP ledger errors (actual - final-window polled): NDA bloc +7.8 (2017), +2.9 (2022); SP bloc -6.0 (2017), +3.0 (2022); BSP +0.7, -0.5

resolution.source: Election Commission of India official results (results.eci.gov.in), party-wise seat tally at first full declaration of all 403 seats
rules: Bloc seat totals = sum of seats won by the member parties listed in `blocs` as composed at freeze; post-result defections, mergers and letters of support are ignored
If an alliance splits BEFORE polling, a re-run forecast (new ledger rows) supersedes; these rows still resolve against freeze-time bloc composition
'wins majority' = bloc seats >= 202 of 403 at first full declaration; countermanded/postponed seats count as not won unless they decide the question, in which case resolution waits for them
'is largest' = strictly more seats than every other modeled bloc (independents and unmodeled parties are not blocs); an exact tie resolves NO for all blocs
Seat-threshold questions (e.g. 'BSP under 25 seats') resolve on the same official tally
If the election is not held by 2027-12-31, rows resolve VOID: logged and excluded from scoring, never silently dropped

quality_flags: ALL four polls are from unrated agencies; none discloses methodology/sample/fieldwork dates (aitimeline.in audit, Sep 2026). M3 runs with inflated sigma and this forecast cannot upgrade to CALL on these polls alone.
BSP polled range 0.8-11.0 pct across agencies - a 10-point spread on one party is a pollster-quality symptom, not information.
INDIA bloc composition not final: SP-INC seat-sharing unresolved at freeze (INC demands ~150 seats, SP signals ~50).

tripwires.watch: SP-INC seat-sharing collapses (INC exits or fights separately)
tripwires.effect: INDIA loses tau x INC transfer (~1.2 pts) and opposition fragments further; NDA majority probability rises materially

tripwires.watch: A rated agency (CVoter/CSDS-Lokniti/Axis) publishes a vote-share poll
tripwires.effect: M3 upgrades to rated sigma; gate becomes meaningfully decidable

tripwires.watch: Ticket-season defection flow (late 2026/early 2027), net direction weighted by defector quality
tripwires.effect: insider-flow signal; sustained one-way flow is grounds to re-run forecast

tripwires.watch: BSP-ASP(KR) dynamics: ASP contesting ~87 seats; any BSP-ASP tie-up or BSP revival sign
tripwires.effect: changes Dalit-vote split assumptions; re-run with ASP as modeled entrant
freeze window formally ends; issue updated pre-registered forecast
